title: pi-governor configuration
description: Budgets and enforcement behaviour for the pi-governor extension.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the extension is inert.

warnRatio.description: Fraction of a limit at which warnings begin.

timeMode.description: Whether the time limit counts wall-clock time or time spent inside agent runs.

exposeTool.description: Register a governor_status tool the model can call.

limits.description: Set a limit to null (or omit it) to leave it unenforced.

contextPercent.description: Context window ceiling as a percentage.

turns.description: Maximum number of completed assistant turns.

enabled.description: Act on exceeded limits instead of only reporting them.

onToolCall.description: Block tool calls once a limit is exceeded.

onPrompt.description: Refuse new user prompts once a limit is exceeded.

onTurn.description: Abort the running agent at the end of a turn once a limit is exceeded. Off by default because blocking tool calls already forces a tool-free wrap-up that keeps the model's explanation; enable for a hard stop where even that turn is unwanted spend.

onContext.description: Compact the context once the context limit is crossed.

onPreflight.description: React before a turn that is projected to cross the cost limit is spent. 'refuse' stops the turn before it is paid for.

preflight.description: Price the next turn before it is spent, so a cost limit cannot overshoot by up to one full turn.

assumedOutputTokens.description: Output tokens to assume when pricing the next turn.

useCacheEstimate.description: Credit the observed cache hit rate. Off assumes a cold cache, which is the conservative worst case.

segments.description: Which metrics to render and in what order.
